subject: Mutual Action Plan — starter slate, confirm stakeholders & close options
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — starter slate, confirm stakeholders & close options

Hi Ellen —

Great conversation this morning; thanks for the time. As promised, attaching a starter Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones we discussed and two timeline options so your team can pick the pace that best fits resource availability. High‑level recap below and a couple of asks to keep momentum: 

Quick recap from discovery:
- Primary use case: clinical notes augmentation for care managers (low-latency generation + PII redaction).
- Nonfunctional musts: SOC2 evidence, SSO + SCIM, and data retention controls in region (US East).
- Key internal stakeholders: you (project sponsor), Rajiv (CTO), Maya (security).

Starter MAP highlights (attached: redwood_map_draft_novamed_v1.xlsx):
- Milestone 1 — Kickoff + stakeholder alignment (owner: Novamed sponsor)
- Milestone 2 — Security questionnaire & SSO scoping (owner: Novamed security)
- Milestone 3 — Pilot integration (owner: Redwood SE)
- Milestone 4 — Pilot verification & QA (owner: Novamed PM)
- Milestone 5 — Procurement signature & SOW (owner: Novamed procurement)

Timeline options (select one):
A) Accelerated (6 weeks): Kickoff next week —> pilot in 3 weeks —> close in 6 weeks (requires prioritized security review and procurement slot)
B) Measured (12 weeks): Kickoff in 2 weeks —> standard security review cadence —> close in 12 weeks (recommended for teams with queued audits)

Ask: please reply with the following by EOD Thursday so we can lock calendar items:
1) Confirm the two Novamed stakeholders who will own the security questionnaire and procurement tasks (name + email).
2) Choose timeline A or B (or suggest another cadence).
3) Who is the final contract signer (procurement contact)?

Dependencies called out in the MAP: SOC2 evidence package (we can provide), SSO/SCIM integration (depends on Novamed IdP readiness), and data residency confirmation. I flagged the security questionnaire as critical path — if your security team can target a 5 business day turnaround, the accelerated timeline is attainable.

Attachment: redwood_map_draft_novamed_v1.xlsx (starter MAP with milestones & owners)

I’ll coordinate a 30‑minute kickoff once you share stakeholders so we can get technical attendees on the invite. Thanks again — excited to partner.

Best,
Marcus Lin

Thanks for the clear recap and draft MAP. Quick answers and one ask below. 

Stakeholder owners (confirmed):
- Security questionnaire + SSO scoping: Maya Rao <maya.rao@novamed.com>
- Procurement / final signer: Tom Lee <tom.lee@novamed.com>
- Technical lead for pilot: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@novamed.com>

Target cadence: the team prefers the Measured (12-week) option given an upcoming internal audit. Can we aim for a target close of 2027-10-15? That gives us runway to complete the audit and run the pilot.

Two clarifying asks: 
1) Can you confirm what items you need from our security team in the first pass of the questionnaire? We likely need an itemized checklist.
2) Any constraints on the pilot environment (we prefer a sandbox hosted in our AWS account rather than a Redwood-managed sandbox)?

I attached our internal infra requirements doc (novamed_security_requirements_v2.pdf) for your engineering team's review.

Appreciate the quick confirmations and the infra doc — very helpful. Per replies above, here's what I updated and next steps: 

What I changed:
- MAP updated: added Ben Carter as SE owner for Pilot integration; added a Data Retention SLA line item for procurement. (Attachment: map_novamed_v1.1.xlsx)
- Timeline set to Measured (12 weeks) and target close: 2027-10-15 (we'll track dates per milestone in the MAP).

Immediate next steps:
1) Marcus/Ben: review novamed_security_requirements_v2.pdf and produce a 1‑page tech scoping doc by EOD Tuesday.
2) Maya: if you can flag any mandatory controls up front (SSO, logging, encryption at rest) we will incorporate into the security questionnaire responses.
3) Tom: I'll share the procurement checklist and sample SOW for your review; can we schedule a 30‑minute sync the week of Jul 19?
4) Ellen/Rajiv: please confirm a preferred date/time for kickoff (we suggest Wed Jul 21 or Thu Jul 22 morning PST).

I'll circulate a calendar invite once the kickoff slot is selected and upload the updated MAP to the deal record. If anything else should live in the MAP (e.g., success metrics or acceptance criteria), call it out and we'll add it.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.
